cuts.reason: Cuts from the wide two-shot inside the car to a tight close-up on the wife right after Paul's 'You say that every week' line, isolating her deadpan expression before she fires back the punchline.

Cuts away from the wife's close-up back to a medium shot of Paul the instant her punchline 'Because it happens every week, Paul' lands, letting his reaction/the show title card land on his face for the beat.
Cuts from the in-scene shot straight to a black end card with the show logo and 'new episode daily' tag, closing the episode immediately after the punchline beat with no lingering.

reaction_shots.description: Close-up on the wife's unimpressed, deadpan face as she delivers the punchline 'Because it happens every week, Paul' — her flat expression is the visual payoff of the joke as much as the line itself.

pacing_notes: The edit holds on only two real story shots: a ~4.4s wide establishing shot of the couple in traffic for the setup exchange, then a slightly longer ~4.9s close-up on the wife's deadpan face to deliver the punchline. Once the joke lands, pacing snaps much faster into two brief branding beats (~0.9s and ~1.2s) — a title-card overlay then a hard cut to a black end card — giving the setup/punchline room to breathe before rapid-fire sign-off.
